description: This file defines an abstract base class 'FormController' for handling form-related controllers in Drupal, including methods for invoking forms, extracting form arguments, and building form objects.

classes.name: FormController
classes.description: An abstract base class for form controllers in Drupal, providing methods to invoke forms and extract form definitions from route matches.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the argument resolver and form builder dependencies.

methods.name: getContentResult
methods.description: Invokes the form and returns the resulting render array, handling form argument extraction and form building.

methods.name: getFormArgument
methods.description: Abstract method to extract the form class or service ID from a route match.

methods.name: getFormObject
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the form object based on route match and form argument.
